items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: My daughters, Sharon and Sylvia, and my wife, Mary Lou, and I, went down there five years ago.

ctx.x: Genealogy, yeah; the family tree. My daughters, Sharon and Sylvia, and my wife, Mary Lou, and I, went down there five years ago. It didn't matter it me, but they were interested, so they went to the Hall of Records and found my father's birth certificate, where he was baptized and the whole bit. So it gives one a sense of family pride.
